text: desktop-notify 为 DSH Desktop 提供 Windows 原生通知。它在 Host 注册 notify 工具，并监听任务结束、提问、审批和错误事件，通过 PowerShell 与 WinRT 显示 toast。通知支持标题、正文、声音和紧急程度，也可按事件自动触发，并对自动提醒限时与限频。适合希望离开屏幕时仍能收到任务状态的用户。需要 Windows 与系统 PowerShell，可使用内置或自选 WAV 音频。

desktop-notify adds native Windows alerts to DSH Desktop. Its Host tool sends toasts through PowerShell and WinRT, and lifecycle listeners can alert on completed turns, questions, approvals, and errors. Users can set text, urgency, and WAV sound. Requires Windows and PowerShell.
DSH 长任务结束后能不能自动提醒我？
我想在离开电脑时收到 agent 完成工作的桌面通知
让 DSH 在需要我回答问题时弹出系统提醒
有没有办法在 agent 等待审批时通知我？
DSH 任务报错时希望 Windows 弹个通知
我想手动让 agent 给我发一条桌面提醒
Notify me on Windows when a DSH agent finishes a long task.
I want a desktop alert when the agent needs my answer or approval.
desktop-notify 的 notify 工具可发送 Windows toast：提供标题、可选正文、静音选项及 info、attention 或 blocked 紧急程度；blocked 使用较长的提醒样式。
desktop-notify 监听会话 turn/start 与 turn/end；持续达到设定时长且没有其他活动会话时，自动用会话标题和最后一条助手文本摘要通知用户。
desktop-notify 会在 DSH 发出提问或审批请求时通知用户，并在 agent/error 事件发生时显示错误提醒；这些自动通知可按事件类型配置开关。
desktop-notify 支持内置 ciallo 声音、Windows 通知 WAV 别名或自定义 WAV 路径；发送时可关闭声音，默认声音文件也可由环境变量选择。
desktop-notify 的原生 toast 只在 Windows 实现，并依赖系统 PowerShell；其他平台的发送操作会返回仅支持 Windows 的提示。
desktop-notify 会在临时目录写入状态 JSON 和事件日志用于诊断；可用 DSH_DESKTOP_NOTIFY_STATE 指定状态文件路径。

@local/dsh-desktop-notify 提供工具 notify：Show a native Windows notification (with sound) to the user. Use it when a long task finishes, when you need the user's attention, when you are blocked on a question/approval, or when the user asked to be pinged.

@local/dsh-desktop-notify README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Dax233/dsh-desktop-notify
```

安装后重启 DSH Desktop；通知样式与声音受 Windows 通知设置影响。

---
@local/dsh-desktop-notify README · @local/dsh-desktop-notify：Native Windows system notifications for the DSH agent, with the system sound.

@local/dsh-desktop-notify README · How it works：- **Host half** (`index.js` + `toast.js`): registers the `notify` tool and sends the
  toast directly through Windows PowerShell + WinRT (`ToastNotificationManager`),
  using the DSH AppUserModelID `electron.app.DeepSeek Harness` read from the installed
  Start-Menu shortcut, so toasts are branded **DeepSeek Harness**. Sound is played
  explicitly with `System.Media.SoundPlayer` (system WAV), so a muted
  notification-sound setting does not silence the alert.
- Why not the renderer Web Notification API: on the target machine it delivered
  nothing at all (not even to the Action Center), while WinRT toasts do reach the
  Action Center. No `node-notifier`/SnoreToast (LGPL) dependency either.

@local/dsh-desktop-notify README · How it works：Research note (2026-10-22): DSH exposes no plugin-level notification API (only the
desktop main process uses Electron `Notification` for mandatory updates), and the
main-process module is not reachable from a plugin. Existing open-source agent
notification tools are CLI hook scripts (macOS `osascript`, PowerShell WinRT, or
`node-notifier` + SnoreToast); none is a DSH plugin. The renderer Web Notification
path is the zero-dependency fit here.

@local/dsh-desktop-notify README · Tool surface：`notify({ title, body?, sound?, urgency?, tag?, action? })`

| field | meaning |
|---|---|
| `title` | short headline (required) |
| `body` | one or two lines of context |
| `sound` | default `true`; `false` sends a silent toast |
| `urgency` | `info` (default) / `attention` / `blocked` (blocked uses `requireInteraction`, stays until dismissed) |
| `tag` | a newer toast with the same tag replaces the older one |
| `action` | `send` (default) or `status` |

@local/dsh-desktop-notify README · Tool surface：Usage guidance given to the model: one notification per meaningful state change —
task finished, blocked on the user, or the user asked to be pinged.

@local/dsh-desktop-notify README · Tests：```powershell
cd <repo>
node --test tests/notify-client.test.mjs tests/notify-host.test.mjs
```

Client tests execute the real `client.js` in a Node VM with a mocked
`Notification` class (grant / request-permission / denial paths, silent flag,
round-trip result). Host tests cover the tool schema (wire-ready JSON Schema),
status, empty-title rejection and a fake-client round-trip.

@local/dsh-desktop-notify README · Requirements / limitations：- Windows toast permission comes from the DSH desktop app; if Windows notification
  settings disable the app, the tool reports `permission is denied`.
- Desktop-only (needs the DSH desktop renderer and its Web Notification support).
- Sound volume/focus-assist is controlled by Windows; the plugin can only choose
  silent vs default sound.

详细设计与排障：见 [docs/desktop-notify.md](docs/desktop-notify.md)。
